title: Vision Plans Coverage Activation and the Binder Deadline
content:
**Evidence of Coverage, Vision Plans — Article on the Start of Coverage**

An applied enrollment becomes active on its coverage effective date once the binder premium has been received. Where the binder arrives after the effective date but within the binder deadline, the enrollment becomes active retroactively to that date.

An applied vision enrollment may be cancelled for an unpaid binder only after the binder deadline has passed following the coverage effective date of the vision enrollment. The binder deadline is the coverage effective date plus the plan's binder deadline days (30) in calendar days. Cancellation is allowed only strictly after that date.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The coverage effective date of the vision enrollment |
| Record relied on | The enrollment's coverage effective date, for that enrollment |
| Length | 30 calendar days |
| Comparison | Cancellation strictly after the deadline date; the deadline day itself does not qualify |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-day binder period).**

- Coverage effective 1 May: the binder deadline is 31 May. A cancellation for an unpaid binder on 31 May is not allowed; on 1 June it is allowed.
- Coverage effective 1 May, binder received on 20 May: the enrollment becomes active, effective 1 May.

An enrollment cancelled for an unpaid binder moves from applied to cancelled, its termination date being the day before the coverage effective date.
